_comment: Agile Agent Team — Antigravity Mission Configuration (Squad Template)
_description: Reference template describing the six workspaces that the /mission workflow dispatches. Antigravity does not load this file directly — the operational source of truth is .agent/workflows/full-mission.md. Keep this file in sync when you change the workflow so it stays a useful blueprint.
_path_convention: All per-mission paths are rooted at session_folder (.agent-missions/mission-{timestamp}/). The task_template fields below use explicit .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/... paths so sub-agents never have to guess the working directory.

mission.name: Agile Agent Team Mission
mission.description: Replace this with your business goal before launching.

workspaces.name: Product Owner
workspaces.task_template: Read the mission brief in .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/mission.md. Follow your skill to produce user stories and acceptance criteria. Save all artifacts to .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/artifacts/po/. Save the handoff to .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/handoffs/po-to-architect.md.

workspaces.name: Software Architect
workspaces.task_template: Read all PO artifacts in .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/artifacts/po/ and the handoff in .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/handoffs/po-to-architect.md. Follow your skill to design the architecture. Save artifacts to .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/artifacts/architect/. Save both handoffs: .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/handoffs/architect-to-qa.md and .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/handoffs/architect-to-dev.md.

workspaces.name: QA Engineer (Planning)
workspaces.task_template: You are in PLANNING MODE. Read .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/artifacts/po/acceptance-criteria.md and .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/artifacts/architect/api-contracts.yaml. Write failing tests for every AC under .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/tests/. Create .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/tests/run_tests.sh and .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/tests/DEV_HANDOFF.md. Save the test plan to .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/artifacts/qa/test-plan.md. Save the handoff to .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/handoffs/qa-to-dev.md.

workspaces.name: Developer (Setup)
workspaces.task_template: You are in SETUP MODE. Read .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/artifacts/architect/architecture-decision-record.md and .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/artifacts/architect/task-breakdown.md. Scaffold the project directory and placeholder files under .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/src/, and install dependencies. Do NOT write any implementation code. Save the handoff to .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/handoffs/dev-setup-complete.md.

workspaces.name: Developer (Implementation)
workspaces.task_template: You are in IMPLEMENTATION MODE. Read .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/tests/DEV_HANDOFF.md first, then the ADR and task-breakdown under .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/artifacts/architect/. Run ./.agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/tests/run_tests.sh to confirm all failing. Implement tasks in order until every test passes. Do NOT modify any test file. Write .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/artifacts/dev/implementation-notes.md and save the handoff to .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/handoffs/dev-to-qa.md.

workspaces.name: QA Engineer (Verification)
workspaces.task_template: You are in VERIFICATION MODE. Run ./.agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/tests/run_tests.sh against the implementation. If all tests pass, produce .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/artifacts/qa/sign-off.md and .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/handoffs/qa-signoff.md with STATUS: COMPLETE. If any test fails, produce .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/artifacts/qa/bug-report.md and .agent-missions/{MISSION_ID}/handoffs/qa-to-dev-cycle.md with STATUS: BLOCKED.

parallel-phase-3.description: QA writes failing tests while Dev scaffolds the project — both inside the same mission folder.

model_assignments._comment: Recommended defaults. Verify these identifiers against Antigravity's current model picker and adjust for your budget.
